summary: Markets are broadly risk-off today: crypto has fallen to two-month lows amid regulatory uncertainty, a Binance heist, heavy ETF outflows, Nvidia-related volatility, and geopolitical tension.[5][6][7] Bitcoin is near $74,000 with $75,000 identified as a key recovery threshold, while Ethereum and major altcoins are underperforming and leveraged liquidations have exceeded $1 billion.[1][2]
